windowDays.description: The observation window the demand figures cover.

basis.description: The formula version the plan was computed under.

nextCursor.description: Empty on the last page; else the `createdAt|planId` pair of the last item.

422.description: The request is malformed or breaks a rule. Problem types: `validation-failed`, `case-pack-not-uniform` (`ErrCasePackNotUniform`), `case-qty-mismatches-gtin` (`ErrCaseQtyMismatchesGtin`), `carton-overweight` (`ErrCartonOverweight`), `carton-oversize` (`ErrCartonOversize`), `invalid-sscc` (`ErrInvalidSscc`), `carton-contents-mismatch-plan` (`ErrCartonContentsMismatchPlan`), `inbound-capacity-exceeded` (`ErrInboundCapacityExceeded`, ADR 0015), `network-split-destination` (`ErrNetworkSplitDestination`, ADR 0015) and `network-split-unavailable` (`ErrNetworkSplitUnavailable`, ADR 0015).

type.description: Problem type slug: the shared `not-found`, `illegal-transition`, `concurrent-update` and `validation-failed`, or one slug per `Err...` name of this context, for example `sscc-not-unique`.

detail.example: sscc not unique: 006141420000000011 is already in this shipment

500.description: An unexpected failure (`internal-error`); the `detail` never carries the internal message. A 5xx is never stored by the idempotency middleware, so the same `Idempotency-Key` retries the real work.
